evidence_scope: RNAplfold (-W 100 -L 100 -u 10, ViennaRNA 2.7.2) accuracy comparison against Raccess Exact, matching Table 1's 12,872 bpRNA sequences (100-1,000 nt) and window lengths w in {1,3,7,10}. RNAplfold computes the same accessibility quantity via a different algorithm: local sliding-window folding averaged over all windows containing the region, rather than Raccess's single global ensemble with a span cutoff.
